ctx.x: And like I say, I used to go over to this guy's house and discuss music. And, then there was a professor of brass instruments at Jenkins. Professor Blake was his name. And, he -- we became good friends. I used to go up to his house. He was a graduate of Howard University. And, he was a tuba player, and we became friends, and I used to go up to his place.
